messages:
camille: Pinned mock for the new token-burn panel in the console — added a compact legend to show cache savings, slabs, and routing delta. PTAL: https://mock.redwood/costs/legend
devon: Looked through it. Legend is useful but worried about clutter when users toggle multiple routes. Can we collapse by default and have an expand affordance?
maria: +1 to collapse. Also we need to be explicit about how cache credits are applied in the billing preview — currently it's ambiguous whether prefetch hits reduce billable tokens.
camille: Proposed copy: "Net tokens = raw tokens - cache credits applied per-session". Clear enough?
nate: Suggestion: make it explicit which cache types are subtracted. E.g. "cache credits = KV cache hits + prefetch hits (when applicable)". Otherwise folks assume prefetch is always free.
devon: Backend already emits tokens.raw, tokens.kv_cache_hits, tokens.prefetch_hits. For the preview we compute: tokens.net = tokens.raw - (tokens.kv_cache_hits + tokens.prefetch_hits) *but use GREATEST(...,0)* to avoid negatives on streaming partials.
devon: SQL snippet I'm using in the preview:
```
SELECT tenant_id, model,
  SUM(GREATEST(raw_tokens - kv_hits - prefetch_hits, 0)) AS billable_tokens,
  SUM(raw_tokens) AS raw_tokens
FROM invocation_tokens
GROUP BY tenant_id, model;
```
maria: That looks right. Also surface a small per-request breakdown in the tooltip: raw / kv_hits / prefetch / net so support can quickly validate.
camille: UI idea: collapsed legend by default with a tiny "Show breakdown" chevron. Tooltip expands to per-request lines on hover/click. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deploy queued for console:feature/cost-legend at commit abc123 — ETA ~3m.
nate: One more thing — routing impact. We should surface a micro bar showing cost split by routing outcome (local / fallback / remote) and a "routing delta" % that estimates how much extra cost sticky-routing or region fallback adds. Sampling at 0.1% should keep compute cheap.
devon: Agreed. Implementation note: compute routing_delta = (cost_with_routing - cost_without_routing) / cost_without_routing. We'll show 95% CI based on sample. Keep sampling configable.
maria: For rollout UX: default collapsed legend + "power user" reveal. Also add a lightweight "Simulate routing change" toggle so teams can preview cost if they change policy to prefer cheaper regions.
camille: Acceptance criteria for the PR: 1) legend collapsed by default, 2) tooltip expands to show raw/kv/prefetch/net per request, 3) backend SQL uses GREATEST to avoid negatives, 4) routing delta shown with sampling at 0.1% and CI.
devon: I'll gate behind a feature flag cost_panel_legend_v1 and roll to 10% canary.
nate: Please add docs and a short FAQ blurb: "How net tokens are calculated" and "Why enabling prefetch can change my preview cost" — prevents noisy support tickets.
maria: Also add a link in the tooltip to "How prefetch & KV caching affect billing".
camille: Mock updated with the copy and the FAQ links. Thanks folks. :sparkles:
infra-bot: Deploy successful to canary (10%) — console:feature/cost-legend @abc123
nate: Canary looks good. Legend collapsed by default, tooltip expands, quick spot-check for tenant `acme` matches SQL output. :ok_hand:
maria: I'll monitor for 24h and open follow-up if any regressions.
